title: ER = EPR
example_questions: Are entangled particles connected by wormholes?
What if two black holes were entangled?
summary: The conjecture that quantum entanglement and Einstein-Rosen bridges (non-traversable wormholes) are two descriptions of the same thing. Two maximally entangled black holes would be joined by a wormhole, which cannot be used to send signals faster than light.
support_note: Influential in quantum gravity research; still a conjecture.
what_happens: Two black holes are created entangled
Their interiors are connected by a bridge
Nothing can cross from one mouth to the other
objections: Unclear how it applies to ordinary entangled particles

sources.title: Cool horizons for entangled black holes
